list.name: run_id
list.label: Rodada (run_id)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM saga_auditoria ORDER BY run_id DESC

options.content: As nove métricas abaixo são calculadas a partir de `saga_auditoria` (audit-db) para a rodada selecionada em **Rodada (run_id)**, com a mesma lógica de `RegistroAuditoriaJpaRepository.resumirSagas` / `AuditoriaUseCase.calcularMetricas`. Complementam a visão operacional (HTTP/JVM) do dashboard *Saga — visão operacional*.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida
  FROM saga_auditoria
  WHERE run_id = '$run_id'
  GROUP BY solicitacao_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(concluida) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Taxa de sucesso"
FROM sagas;

panels.title: Tempo médio de conclusão da saga

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio), 0) AS "Tempo médio de conclusão"
FROM sagas WHERE concluida = 1 AND fim IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Tempo médio de recuperação após falhas

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS primeira_falha,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falhas
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fim - primeira_falha), 0) AS "Tempo médio de recuperação"
FROM sagas WHERE falhas > 0 AND fim IS NOT NULL AND primeira_falha IS NOT NULL;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falhas,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'COMPENSACAO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compensacoes
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
),
agregado AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS com_falha,
    SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 AND concluida = 1 AND compensacoes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recuperadas_sem_compensacao
  FROM sagas
)
SELECT CASE WHEN com_falha > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * recuperadas_sem_compensacao / com_falha, 2) ELSE 0 END AS "% recuperadas sem compensação"
FROM agregado;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
),
agregado AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, MIN(inicio) AS menor_inicio, MAX(fim) AS maior_fim
  FROM sagas WHERE inicio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE WHEN maior_fim > menor_inicio
            THEN ROUND(total / ((maior_fim - menor_inicio) / 1000.0), 3)
            ELSE 0 END AS "Throughput"
FROM agregado;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Compensações"
FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND acao = 'COMPENSACAO';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Retries"
FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND acao = 'RETRY';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Eventos registrados"
FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id';

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio), 0) AS "Tempo até consistência eventual"
FROM sagas WHERE fim IS NOT NULL AND inicio IS NOT NULL;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_COMPENSADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compensada,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_ABORTADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abortada,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_REJEITADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejeitada
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
)
SELECT 'Concluída' AS resultado, SUM(concluida)::int AS quantidade FROM sagas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Compensada', SUM(compensada)::int FROM sagas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Abortada', SUM(abortada)::int FROM sagas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rejeitada', SUM(rejeitada)::int FROM sagas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Em andamento', SUM(CASE WHEN concluida = 0 AND compensada = 0 AND abortada = 0 AND rejeitada = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int FROM sagas;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY solicitacao_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT to_timestamp(fim / 1000.0) AS "time", COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY fim) AS "Sagas finalizadas"
FROM sagas
ORDER BY fim;
